name: Abacaxi Ricaço
headline: Abacaxi Ricaço
description: Discover how to make an Abacaxi Ricaço using Pineapple (fresh), Light gold rum 1-3yo, Lime juice and Superfine/caster sugar in 6 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a PINEAPPLE SHELL (FROZEN) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off a small pineapple and carefully scoop out the flesh from the base to leave a shell with 12mm (½ inch) thick walls. Place the shell in a freezer to chill.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a straw sized hole in the sliced off top of the pineapple shell for use as a lid.

recipeInstructions.name: BLEND
recipeInstructions.text: Remove the hard core from the pineapple flesh and discard; roughly chop the remaining flesh, add other ingredients and BLEND with one 12oz scoop of crushed ice.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR into the pineapple shell. (The flesh of one pineapple blended with other ingredients will fill two shells.)

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Serve with a straw.

name: Berry Caipirinha
headline: Berry Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Berry Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Superfine/caster sugar, Raspberries, Blackberries (+ 3 more) in 11 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: CUT
recipeInstructions.text: CUT lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add berries and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: Transfer
recipeInstructions.text: When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz highball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass.

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: FILL glass with small cubes or cracked ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

name: Blue Blazer
headline: Blue Blazer
description: Discover how to make a Blue Blazer using Scotch whisky, Boiling water and Powdered sugar in 11 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-heat a SNIFTER/BRANDY BALLOON GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: WARNING - Igniting alcohol is extremely dangerous, so take great care, and please practice with water first to perfect your method. Stand on a non-flammable floor and have help and suitable fire-fighting equipment nearby.

recipeInstructions.name: Serves
recipeInstructions.text: This recipe makes two cocktails.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of two lemon zest twists.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat a pair of large silver-plated tankards (blazer mugs) with handles with boiling water and pre-warm the whisky by standing the bottle in hot water.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR the whisky into one tankard and fresh boiling water into the other.

recipeInstructions.name: IGNITE
recipeInstructions.text: IGNITE the whisky using a long match and while still blazing pour the whisky into the other tankard.

recipeInstructions.name: THROW
recipeInstructions.text: THROW the flaming mixture from one tankard to the other. (The foolhardy increase the distance between the tankards as they pour, thus creating a spectacular long blue flame between the two.)

recipeInstructions.name: Extinguish
recipeInstructions.text: EXTINGUISH flame by covering flaming tankard with base of the other tankard.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR into glasses and sweeten to taste by stirring in powdered sugar.

recipeInstructions.name: Express
recipeInstructions.text: EXPRESS a lemon zest over each cocktail and use as garnish.

name: Brandy Crusta

description: Discover how to make a Brandy Crusta using Cognac (brandy), Orange Curaçao, Maraschino liqueur, Sugar syrup (2:1) (+ 3 more) in 8 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a FLUTE GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: CRUSTA
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare the glass with citrus peel and sugar CRUSTA by first finding a whole lemon that fits snugly inside the top of your glass with its equator in contact with the rim of the glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Cut
recipeInstructions.text: Cut off both ends of the fruit to leave a central slice a little more than 25ml (1 inch) thick.

recipeInstructions.name: Ring
recipeInstructions.text: Carefully remove the pulp from this central slice to leave a ring of skin and push this into the top of the glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Moisten
recipeInstructions.text: Moisten the outside rim of the glass and exposed fruit with citrus juice and dip in white caster sugar to heavily frost the edge of both peel and glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Crust
recipeInstructions.text: Leave for a couple of hours to form a hard crust that helps secure the peel. (The ring of citrus peel should become a waterproof extension to the top of the glass.) Place in a freezer to chill the glass ready for the cocktail.

recipeInstructions.name: SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE all ingredients with ice.

recipeInstructions.name: FINE STRAIN
recipeInstructions.text: FINE STRAIN into pre-prepared glass.

name: Caipirinha
headline: Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Powdered sugar, Chilled water and Cachaça in 10 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: Cut
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a ripe lime in half (from pole to pole) and remove the core from each half by cutting a V-shaped groove. (You'll need one-half of the lime per cocktail.) CHOP into wedges and each wedge chopped in half before dropping the resulting 6 or 8 lime chunks into the base of shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons powdered sugar [or 15ml (½oz) sugar syrup 2:1] and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: If using cubed ice straight from the freezer, add chilled water (or optionally add fruit of choice) and MUDDLE some more. If using watery ice then omit some or all of the water/juice.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: When sure the lime's juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, POUR the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz highball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the shaker tin used to muddle and swirl to rinse tin before pouring cachaça into serving glass. STIR to combine with other ingredients.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: FILL glass with small cubes or cracked ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Serve with a stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane) but no straws.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass

recipeInstructions.name: PLACE
recipeInstructions.text: PLACE cube of sugar on a slotted absinthe spoon resting across the top of the glass.

recipeInstructions.name: DRIP
recipeInstructions.text: Using an absinthe fountain (or a bottle of chilled mineral water with a small hole in the cap), DRIP iced water over the sugar so it dissolves and drips into the glass.

description: Discover how to make an Absinthe Drip Cocktail (Czech method) using Absinthe, Chilled water and Superfine/caster sugar with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: BEWARE: please take care
Flames and alcohol are a dangerous combination!
Place a sugar cube on a slotted absinthe spoon resting across the top of the glass
POUR the absinthe over the sugar cube into the glass
Light the absinthe-soaked cube and leave it to burn and caramelise
Using a bottle of chilled mineral water with a small hole in the cap, DRIP water over what's left of the sugar so it dissolves and drips into the glass
Add ice, stir, and serve.

name: Derby Fizz
headline: Derby Fizz
description: Discover how to make a Derby Fizz using Lemon juice, Powdered sugar, Scotch whisky, Orange Curaçao, Egg white (+ 1 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: STIR lemon juice and sugar in base of shaker until sugar is dissolved
Add Scotch and orange curaçao, SHAKE with ice and strain back into shaker

DRY SHAKE (without ice) and slowly pour 2/3rds of the contents of the shaker from a higher than normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand
The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass
As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on a Derby Fizz, the cocktail should be left to settle for at least a minute before topping off with what remains in the shaker
Ideally, during the settling period, the glass should be placed in a glass froster/fridge/freezer
As the final contents of the shaker are poured into the glass so the head should rise like a soufflé.

recipeInstructions.text: When ready to serve, POUR chilled vermouth into icy glass and swirl to coat with vermouth.

name: Morning Glory Fizz
headline: Morning Glory Fizz
description: Discover how to make a Morning Glory Fizz using Single malt Scotch whisky, Absinthe, Lemon juice, Lime juice (+ 3 more) in 8 easy to follow steps
recipeIngredient: Top up with Soda (club soda) water

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of lime slice wheel.

recipeInstructions.name: SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 6 ingredients with ice and strain back into shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: DRY SHAKE (without ice) to emulsify.

recipeInstructions.name: STRAIN
recipeInstructions.text: STRAIN and slowly pour 2/3rds of the contents of the shaker from a higher than normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand. The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Stand
recipeInstructions.text: As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on a fizz, the cocktail should be left to settle for at least a minute before topping off with what remains in the shaker. Ideally, during the settling period, the cocktail should be placed in a glass froster/fridge/freezer.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: Slowly POUR the final contents of the shaker into the glass. The head should rise like a soufflé.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with lime slice wheel.

name: Passion Fruit Caipirinha
headline: Passion Fruit Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Passion Fruit Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Superfine/caster sugar, Passion fruit and Cachaça in 11 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: CUT
recipeInstructions.text: CUT lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Chop passion fruit in half and scoop flesh into the rocks glass and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: TRANSFER
recipeInstructions.text: When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, TRANSFER the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass.

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: FILL glass with small cubes or cracked ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: Briefly STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

headline: Ramos Gin Fizz
description: Discover how to make a Ramos Gin Fizz using Old Tom gin, Lemon juice, Lime juice, Sugar syrup (2:1) (+ 5 more) in 8 easy to follow steps
recipeIngredient: Top up with Soda (club soda) water

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a COLLINS GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of quarter orange wheel (& optional mint sprig).

recipeInstructions.name: SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 8 ingredients with ice and strain back into shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: DRY SHAKE (without ice) to emulsify.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour
recipeInstructions.text: SLOWLY POUR two-thirds of the shaker's contents from a higher-than-normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in the glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand. (The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on a Ramos Gin Fizz, LEAVE TO SETTLE for at least a minute. Ideally, during this settling period, the glass should be placed in a glass-froster/fridge/freezer.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR the final contents of the shaker into the glass. As you do so, the head should rise like a souffle.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with quarter orange wheel on rim (& optional mint sprig bouquet).

name: Raspberry Caipirinha
headline: Raspberry Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Raspberry Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Superfine/caster sugar, Raspberries and Cachaça with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>1.</strong> Cut lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass
<strong>2.</strong> Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE
<strong>3.</strong> Add raspberries and MUDDLE some more
<strong>4.</strong> When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass)
<strong>5.</strong> POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass
STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed
<strong>6.</strong> Crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes and drop into serving glass
STIR before topping with more ice and serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

name: Ti Punch
headline: Ti Punch
description: Discover how to make a Ti Punch using Agricole rhum (unaged), Sugar cane syrup and Lime (fresh) in 6 easy to follow steps

video.name: How to make a Ti Punch
video.description: Watch how to make a Ti Punchusing Agricole rhum (unaged), Sugar cane syrup and Lime (fresh)

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill an OLD-FASHIONED GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of lime peel disc. Traditionally, limes used to make this cocktail are not cut into slices or wedges. Instead, cut a round disc from the side of the fruit, large enough that some of the fruit's flesh backs the peel of the disc.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR the rum and sugar into glass.

recipeInstructions.name: SQUEEZE
recipeInstructions.text: Then SQUEEZE the lime disc between finger and thumb before dropping into the cocktail. (This expresses the oil from the skin and little of the juice into the Ti'Punch.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR and consider adding ice - either one or two large cubes depending on glass size, or preferably, a small chunk of block ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: There's no additional garnish to the lime disc using in the making of this cocktail but some like to serve with a small spoon to enable the drinker to tease out more juice from the lime disc &/or stir ice.

name: Tom and Jerry (serves 6)
headline: Tom and Jerry (serves 6)
description: Discover how to make a Tom and Jerry (serves 6) using Egg white, Egg yolk, Superfine/caster sugar (+ 7 more) in 8 easy to follow steps
recipeIngredient: 15 ml OP high ester aged pot still rum

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-heat a TODDY GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of grated nutmeg.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm
recipeInstructions.text: Pre-warm six 20cl (6.75oz) toddy glasses or Tom and Jerry mugs with hot water.

recipeInstructions.name: BEAT
recipeInstructions.text: Using a whisk, BEAT the yolks in a mixing bowl 'until they are thin as water.' Add sugar, Jamaican rum, spices and STIR thoroughly with whisk.

recipeInstructions.name: BEAT
recipeInstructions.text: In a separate bowl, use a whisk to BEAT the egg whites 'to a stiff froth.'

recipeInstructions.name: Fold
recipeInstructions.text: Use a tablespoon to FOLD the frothy egg whites into the spiced and beaten yolk mixture. This produces the gloopy base mixture known as 'Tom and Jerry batter'.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour
recipeInstructions.text: To make individual drinks, to each of the warmed glasses or mugs, POUR cognac and rum, and add two table spoons of Tom and Jerry batter. STIR each glass/mug thoroughly with a barspoon while topping with boiling water.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Each should end up with frothy head ready to receive the garnish of grated nutmeg.

headline: Tropical Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Tropical Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Powdered sugar, Cachaça, Coconut rum liqueur and Pineapple juice with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>1.</strong> Cut lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass
<strong>2.</strong> Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz/15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE
<strong>3.</strong> When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass)

<strong>4</strong> POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer), coconut liqueur and pineapple juice (also chilled) into the shaker base or glass used to muddle and swirl to rinse before pouring into serving glass
STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed
<strong>5.</strong> Use an <a href="/bar-equipment-and-barware/250/ice-tapper">Ice Tapper</a> to crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes and drop into serving glass
STIR before topping with more ice and serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

name: Estrella Porno Martini
headline: Estrella Porno Martini
description: Discover how to make an Estrella Porno Martini using Passion fruit, Blanco tequila, Passionfruit liqueur (+ 3 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>1.</strong> To make a Estrella Porno Martini you'll first need to flavour your tequila with a vanilla pod
Simply cut the vanilla pod lengthways to expose the flavoursome seeds inside and drop the whole vanilla pod into your bottle of tequila
Reseal and shake bottle several times a day for at least two days, preferably a week
<strong>2.</strong> To make your cocktail, wash and cut passion fruits in half, SCOOP out the seeds and flesh of 3 halves into shaker
(Keep last passion fruit half for garnish)
Add next four ingredients (all but champagne), SHAKE with ice and fine strain into chilled glass
POUR champagne into chilled shot glass to serve on the side
Instruct drinker to sip alternately from each glass.

name: Blueberry Caipirinha
headline: Blueberry Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Blueberry Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Superfine/caster sugar, Blueberries (fresh) and Cachaça in 11 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: CUT
recipeInstructions.text: CUT lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add blueberries and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: Transfer
recipeInstructions.text: When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz highball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass. STIR to combine all ingredients.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: Fill glass with ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice and serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with stirrer (but no straws).

name: Strawberry and Basil Caipirinha
headline: Strawberry and Basil Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Strawberry and Basil Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Powdered sugar, Strawberries (fresh) (+ 2 more) in 10 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: CUT
recipeInstructions.text: CUT lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons powdered sugar [or 15ml (½oz) sugar syrup 2:1] and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add strawberries and basil, and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: Transfer
recipeInstructions.text: When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz highball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass. STIR to combine all ingredients.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: Fill glass with ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with stirrer and serve without a straw.

headline: French Kiwi and Apple Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a French Kiwi and Apple Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Superfine/caster sugar, Kiwi fruit (fresh) (+ 3 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>1.</strong> Cut lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass
<strong>2.</strong> Add 3 bar spoons caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE
<strong>3.</strong> Add Kiwi fruit and MUDDLE some more
<strong>4.</strong> When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, transfer the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass)
<strong>5.</strong> POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass
Add apple juice and anis liqueur, then STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed
<strong>6.</strong> Crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes and drop into serving glass
STIR before topping with more ice and serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

headline: Caipirinha (no added sugar and low-calorie)
description: Discover how to make a Caipirinha (no added sugar and low-calorie) using Lime (fresh), Sugar-free sweetener syrup (+ 2 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>1.</strong> Cut lime in half (from pole to pole) and slice on half into 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass
<strong>2.</strong> Add sweetener and MUDDLE
<strong>3.</strong> If using cubed ice straight from the freezer, add chilled water (or optionally add fruit of your choice) and MUDDLE some more
If using watery ice then omit water
<strong>4.</strong> When sure muddling has fully extracted fruit juice, POUR the muddled fruit and sweetener into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass)
<strong>5.</strong> POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (the glass used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass
STIR to mix with other ingredients
<strong>6.</strong> If using cubed ice, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes and drop into serving glass
STIR before topping with more ice and serve with a stirrer (but no straws).

name: Clarified Vodka Milk Punch
headline: Clarified Vodka Milk Punch
description: Discover how to make a Clarified Vodka Milk Punch using Cold breakfast tea, Lemon juice, Lemon peel, Orange juice (+ 6 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: <strong>Milk Punch Base pre-batch</strong> (scale-up recipe according to requirement)
<strong>1.</strong> POUR first 7 ingredients (with peels from the zests lemons and orange) into a sealable container and leave to infuse for 12 hours in a refrigerator
<strong>2. Hot milk method</strong> HEAT milk until just starting to simmer and pour (while still simmering) the vodka tea and juice mix into the milk while stirring
As soon as the milk curdles, stop stirring
Chill for at least 2-3 hours and up to 24 hours
<strong>OR 2. Cold milk method</strong> POUR vodka tea and juice mix into cold milk while stirring
As soon as the milk curdles, stop stirring
Chill for at least 2-3 hours and up to 24 hours
<strong>3.</strong> Fine STRAIN mixture through cheesecloth or Superbag into a large jar or another container
Ideally, this should be in a refrigerator (I removed a shelf in ours) with the cheesecloth/bag hung over the jar
<strong>4.</strong> Repeat step three, without removing curds from the filter or move to a finer strainer (e
. from a 400-micron bag to a 100-micron bag) or coffee filter
<strong>5.</strong> Stored in the refrigerator, this will keep for a week (and potentially months), but be sure to sterilise containers, etc
<strong>Cocktail itself</strong>
STIR 50ml pre-prepared Milk Punch Base with 50ml vodka and 7.5ml sugar syrup and strain into an ice-filled glass (preferably over a chunk of block ice)

headline: Strawberry Caipirinha
description: Discover how to make a Strawberry Caipirinha using Lime (fresh), Powdered sugar, Strawberries (fresh) and Cachaça in 11 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: CUT
recipeInstructions.text: CUT lime in half (from pole to pole) and then slice one of the halves into eight 3-4mm thick half-moon shaped segments and drop into the base of a robust rocks glass.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 bar spoons powdered caster sugar (or ½oz / 15ml sugar syrup 2:1) and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add strawberries and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: TRANSFER
recipeInstructions.text: When sure fruit juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, TRANSFER the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz hi-ball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR cachaça (stored in the freezer) into the rocks glass (used to muddle) and swirl to rinse glass before pouring cachaça into serving glass.

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR to ensure all ingredients are well mixed.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: FILL glass with small cubes or cracked ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: Briefly STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with stirrer (but no straws).

name: Bird of Paradise Gin Fizz
headline: Bird of Paradise Gin Fizz
description: Discover how to make a Bird of Paradise Gin Fizz using Old Tom gin, Lime juice, Raspberry syrup, Orange flower water (+ 2 more) with easy to follow steps
recipeIngredient: Top up with Soda (club soda) water

recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 5 ingredients with ice and strain back into shaker

DRY SHAKE (without ice) and slowly pour 2/3rds of the contents of the shaker from a higher than normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand
The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass
As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on a fizz, the cocktail should be left to settle for at least a minute before topping off with what remains in the shaker
Ideally, during the settling period, the glass should be placed in a glass froster/fridge/freezer
As the final contents of the shaker are poured into the glass so the head should rise like a souffle.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 5 ingredients with ice and strain back into the shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: DRY SHAKE (without ice) to emulsify.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: Slowly POUR 2/3rds of the shaker's contents from a higher-than-normal height into chilled glass (no ice in the glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand. The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Top
recipeInstructions.text: As when pouring Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on a fizz, the cocktail should be left to settle for at least a minute before topping off with what remains in the shaker. Ideally, during the settling period, the glass should be placed in a glass froster/fridge/freezer. As the final contents of the shaker are poured into the glass, the head should rise like a souffle.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with quarter lemon wheel on rim.

name: Grapefruit Whisky Fizz
headline: Grapefruit Whisky Fizz
description: Discover how to make a Grapefruit Whisky Fizz using Scotch whisky, Pink grapefruit juice, Lemon juice (+ 4 more) with easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 6 ingredients with ice and strain back into shaker

DRY SHAKE (without ice) and slowly pour 2/3rds of the contents of the shaker from a higher than normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in glass) while simultaneously pouring soda with your other hand
The cocktail and soda should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass
As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head on your fizz, the cocktail should be left to settle for at least a minute before topping off with what remains in the shaker
Ideally, during the settling period, the glass should be placed in a glass froster/fridge/freezer
As the final contents of the shaker are poured into the glass so the head should rise like a souffle.

recipeInstructions.name: SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: SHAKE first 4 ingredients with ice and strain back into shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY SHAKE
recipeInstructions.text: DRY SHAKE (without ice) to emulsify.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: SLOWLY POUR two-thirds of the shaker's contents from a higher-than-normal height into a chilled empty glass (no ice in the glass) while simultaneously pouring ginger beer with your other hand. (The cocktail and ginger ale should form a single stream of liquid falling into the glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: SETTLE
recipeInstructions.text: As when pouring a Guinness, to achieve a perfect head, LEAVE TO SETTLE for at least a minute. Ideally, during this settling period, the glass should be placed in a freezer/glass-froster/fridge.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR the final contents of the shaker into the glass. As you do so, the head should rise like a souffle.

recipeInstructions.name: Express
recipeInstructions.text: EXPRESS lemon zest twist over the cocktail and discard.

recipeInstructions.text: Select a BOTTLE.

recipeInstructions.name: Select
recipeInstructions.text: Use the serve number selector (below the ingredients) to set the number of serves you want in your pre-batch. (x7 serves is recommended as this will fill a standard bottle – see below for x7 volumes and weights).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR all ingredients into a clean, resealable 70cl or 75cl bottle.

recipeInstructions.name: Seal
recipeInstructions.text: Seal the bottle and turn/shake to ensure the integration of ingredients.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Place bottle, along with serving glasses, in a freezer for three hours. (Beware, your cocktail is likely to freeze if left for extended periods.)

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: For each individual serve, POUR 90ml/3oz directly from the frozen bottle into the frozen glasses.

name: Mango Caipiroska
headline: Mango Caipiroska
description: Discover how to make a Mango Caipiroska using Lime (fresh), Powdered sugar, Mango liqueur and Mango flavoured vodka in 10 easy to follow steps

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare glass
recipeInstructions.text: Select and pre-chill a HIGHBALL (MAX 10OZ/300ML) GLASS.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare garnish of stirrer (spoon, wooden lolly stick or stick cut from sugar cane).

recipeInstructions.name: Cut
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a ripe lime in half (from pole to pole) and remove the core from each half by cutting a V-shaped groove. (You'll need one-half of the lime per cocktail.) CHOP into wedges and each wedge chopped in half before dropping the resulting 6 or 8 lime chunks into the base of shaker.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add 2 bar spoons powdered sugar [or 15ml (½oz) sugar syrup 2:1] and MUDDLE.

recipeInstructions.name: MUDDLE
recipeInstructions.text: Add mango liqueur and MUDDLE some more.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: When sure the lime's juice is fully extracted and the sugar dissolved, POUR the muddled fruit and sugar into serving glass (preferably a 30cl / 10oz highball glass).

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: POUR mango vodka (stored in the freezer) into the shaker tin used to muddle and swirl to rinse tin before pouring vodka into serving glass. STIR to mix with other ingredients.

recipeInstructions.name: FILL
recipeInstructions.text: FILL glass with small cubes or cracked ice. (If using large ice cubes, crack (rather than crush) four to five large ice cubes using an ICE TAPPER and drop into serving glass.)

recipeInstructions.name: STIR
recipeInstructions.text: STIR before topping with more ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Serve with a stirrer.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY BLEND
recipeInstructions.text: DRY BLEND (without ice) first 6 ingredients on a slow setting and then gradually add Xanthan while continuing to blend.

recipeInstructions.name: BLEND
recipeInstructions.text: Add 7oz scoop of crushed ice and BLEND some more.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: Now you’ve made the first half of this cocktail, if you have a second blender, use this to continue. Otherwise, POUR the contents of the blender (the first half of the cocktail) into chilled glass and place in a freezer.

recipeInstructions.name: DRY BLEND
recipeInstructions.text: DRY BLEND (without ice) next 4 ingredients (all but Xanthan gum) on a slow setting and then gradually add Xanthan while continuing to blend.

recipeInstructions.name: BLEND
recipeInstructions.text: Add 7oz scoop of crushed ice and BLEND some more.

recipeInstructions.name: POUR
recipeInstructions.text: Either, POUR over first half in the glass from freezer, or, if you have two blenders, place a vertical divider (cut from thin plastic) in the glass and simultaneously pour the contents of both blenders, one on each side of the divider. Remove divider to create a split, two cocktails in one glass effect.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with pineapple wedge skewered with mint sprig-topped strawberry and paper parasol.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish
